segments.ch05.s0010: The Caterpillar and Alice looked at each other for some time in silence.
segments.ch05.s0020: At last the Caterpillar took the hookah out of its mouth.
segments.ch05.s0040: This was not an encouraging opening for a conversation.
segments.ch05.s0050: I hardly know, sir, just at present.
segments.ch05.s0060: I know who I was when I got up this morning.
segments.ch05.s0070: But I think I must have been changed several times since then.
segments.ch05.s0080: What do you mean by that?
segments.ch05.s0100: I cannot explain myself, I am afraid, sir, because I am not myself, you see.
segments.ch05.s0120: Being so many different sizes in a day is very confusing.
segments.ch05.s0140: For some minutes it puffed away without speaking.
segments.ch05.s0150: So you think you are changed, do you?
segments.ch05.s0160: I am afraid I am, sir.
segments.ch05.s0170: I do not keep the same size for ten minutes together!
segments.ch05.s0190: What size do you want to be?
segments.ch05.s0200: Oh, I am not particular as to size.
segments.ch05.s0210: Only one does not like changing so often, you know.
segments.ch05.s0220: I should like to be a little larger, sir, if you would not mind.
segments.ch05.s0230: Three inches is such a wretched height to be.
segments.ch05.s0240: It is a very good height indeed!
segments.ch05.s0250: It reared itself upright as it spoke, for it was exactly three inches high.
segments.ch05.s0260: In a minute or two the Caterpillar yawned once or twice, and shook itself.
segments.ch05.s0270: Then it got down off the mushroom, and crawled away in the grass.
segments.ch05.s0280: One side will make you grow taller, and the other side will make you grow shorter.
segments.ch05.s0320: And in another moment it was out of sight.
segments.ch05.s0330: Alice looked thoughtfully at the mushroom, trying to make out which were its two sides.
segments.ch05.s0340: As it was perfectly round, this was a very difficult question.
segments.ch05.s0350: At last she stretched her arms round it, and broke off a bit of the edge with each hand.
segments.ch05.s0370: She nibbled a little of the right-hand bit to try the effect.
segments.ch05.s0380: The next moment she felt a violent blow underneath her chin.
segments.ch05.s0400: She was shrinking rapidly, so she set to work at once to eat some of the other bit.
segments.ch05.s0410: Her chin was pressed so close to her foot that there was hardly room to open her mouth.
segments.ch05.s0420: But she did it at last, and managed to swallow a morsel of the left-hand bit.
segments.ch05.s0430: Come, my head is free at last!
segments.ch05.s0440: Her delight changed into alarm in another moment.
segments.ch05.s0450: Her shoulders were nowhere to be found.
segments.ch05.s0460: All she could see, when she looked down, was an immense length of neck.
segments.ch05.s0470: It rose like a stalk out of a sea of green leaves that lay far below her.
segments.ch05.s0480: What can all that green stuff be?
segments.ch05.s0490: And where have my shoulders got to?
segments.ch05.s0500: She found that her neck would bend about easily in any direction, like a serpent.
segments.ch05.s0510: The green leaves were nothing but the tops of the trees she had been wandering under.
segments.ch05.s0520: She was going to dive in among them when a sharp hiss made her draw back in a hurry.
segments.ch05.s0530: A large pigeon had flown into her face, and was beating her with its wings.
segments.ch05.s0580: I have tried the roots of trees, and banks, and hedges, but those serpents!
segments.ch05.s0600: And just as I had taken the highest tree in the wood, down they come from the sky!
segments.ch05.s0620: But I am not a serpent, I tell you!
segments.ch05.s0660: I have seen a good many little girls in my time, but never one with such a neck as that!
segments.ch05.s0680: Alice crouched down among the trees, for her neck kept getting tangled in the branches.
segments.ch05.s0690: She remembered that she still held the pieces of mushroom in her hands.
segments.ch05.s0700: She nibbled first at one and then at the other.
segments.ch05.s0710: She grew sometimes taller and sometimes shorter.
segments.ch05.s0720: At last she had brought herself down to her usual height.
